challenge.method: Compare a bare identifier with an initialized identifier and check when initialization takes place.
challenge.results: The initialized form obtains its value from the initializer. The bare form supplies undefined when evaluation reaches that binding. The rule gives no value to an earlier read and does not govern iteration binding initialization.

limitations: This governs declaration evaluation. Reads of a still-uninitialized lexical binding and for-in or for-of binding initialization are separate cases.
This does not prescribe a value for a lexical binding that has yet to be initialized.
